summary: Bulk-embedding requests split between regions during residency pin refresh, causing intermittent p95 latency spikes
description:
Issue summary: During a scheduled residency pin refresh window control-plane rolled pin tokens causing a subset of high-concurrency bulk-embedding requests from LexicoAI to egress via apac-southeast instead of us-east.
Impact: Customer observed p95 latency increase from ~230ms to ~1.9s for bulk embedding jobs and a measurable increase in inter-region egress billing for the affected time window. No request-level 5xxs; embedding results were correct but delayed.
Environment: prod us-east tenant=lexicoai customer_tier=dedicated model=embed-v2-large
Steps to reproduce:
1) Use LexicoAI account API key with region header set to us-east and tenant residency pinned to us-east.
2) Send a batch embedding request with 512 items in parallel (concurrency ~200) using the batch endpoints during a control-plane pin update (observed window 2026-03-10T12:03:00Z - 2026-03-10T12:12:00Z).
3) Observe request traces and egress paths in the Console (per-route traces) and edge proxy logs.
Observed behavior: Roughly 12-17% of requests routed to apac-southeast edges during the window, causing additional TLS handshakes and cross-region hop; p95 latency rose to ~1.9s, p99 up to ~3.7s. Token-level residency header shows us-east but edge-level cache contained stale residency stamp for ~45s on some hosts.
Expected behavior: All requests from a pin-resident tenant in us-east should remain on us-east edges; fallbacks to secondary regions only after explicit failover logic or when capacity constraints are hit.
Logs and metrics (excerpt):
[2026-03-10T12:04:11Z] edge/us-east-2 proxy: incoming tenant=lexicoai pin=us-east conn_id=abc123
[2026-03-10T12:04:11Z] edge/us-east-2 router: lookup pin->control-plane -> control-plane returned pin_refresh_in_progress=true, stamp_id=st-482
[2026-03-10T12:04:12Z] edge/apac-1 proxy: incoming tenant=lexicoai conn_id=def456 egress=apac-southeast
[2026-03-10T12:04:12Z] serving-runtime/us-east node: started batch job job_id=job-88 shard=0 latency_ms=1850
[2026-03-10T12:05:00Z] billing: interregion-egress bytes=3.4GB cost=USD 18.35
Additional notes: Customer reported the spike during their nightly bulk embed run; they provided timestamps and traces attached in their initial message.
comments: Support (Aisha) 2026-03-10: Opened after customer escalation. Collected initial traces and asked for bulk request examples and timestamps.
LexicoAI (Customer) 2026-03-10: Provided request ids [r-441, r-442, r-443], timestamps and a sample cURL for the batch request. Confirmed tenant pin set to us-east in Console.
SRE (Diego) 2026-03-10: Noted control-plane pin rotation at 2026-03-10T12:03:30Z; pulling edge cache logs to correlate. Suspect partial stamp mismatch combined with DNS rebalance.

Support (Aisha) 2026-03-11: Added metric dashboards for p95/p99 and egress bytes. Recommending temporary mitigation: throttle batch concurrency or enable per-request 'strict_residency' header as a stopgap.

SRE (Diego) 2026-03-12: Found ~40 edge hosts with stale residency stamp TTLs (~30-60s) and one router instance replaying an out-of-date stamp due to delayed control-plane push. Creating a hotfix to add stamp-version check on router to prefer local pin state.
Support (Aisha) 2026-03-12: Informed customer of planned hotfix and recommended running a reduced concurrency window for next day; customer accepted.
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: During control-plane's rolling pin refresh we have a race where some edges consult local cache (stale) and router instances that have not yet received the new stamp routing policy. Combined with heavy concurrency and batch affinity, some batches were sharded to nodes that had evicted old pin->region mapping, causing fallback route selection to APAC edges. Evidence: control-plane push logs show delayed ACK from 03 router hosts; edge cache TTLs show 30-60s overlap. Correlated billing egress spikes match timestamps.
Next steps: (1) Deploy router-side stamp-version check to prefer latest push (PR linked). (2) Add telemetry to flag routing divergence per-tenant during pin refresh windows. (3) Backfill runbook to advise customers to avoid high-concurrency bulk jobs during planned pin rotations.
workaround: Customer workaround: reduce concurrency to under 40 simultaneous requests for bulk embedding runs during the maintenance window; alternatively set 'strict_residency=true' on requests (temporary) to force fail with clear error instead of fallback routing. Support provided cURL examples for strict_residency header.
resolution_notes: In progress — hotfix PR #712 deployed to staging and validated with synthetic high-concurrency runs reproducing earlier divergence. Plan: rollout to prod canary 2026-03-13 and full rollout 2026-03-14 pending no regressions. Postmortem will be created after full rollout with monitoring for egress anomalies. Billing adjustment request submitted for LexicoAI for measured interregion egress during the incident window.
